title: Breast Cancer Awareness Workshop – KidZania Kuwait
summary: A meaningful breast cancer awareness initiative brought together female employees of KidZania, Tekzone and Quest, reinforcing the importance of early detection, informed healthcare decisions and a proactive approach to women's health.
description:
Organised as part of the Pinktober breast cancer awareness initiative, the workshop provided an opportunity to engage directly with women working across KidZania, Tekzone and Quest.

The session explored breast cancer risk factors, the importance of recognising potential warning signs, and the role of timely medical consultation and appropriate screening. Through an accessible educational presentation, the programme encouraged participants to become more informed and confident about taking care of their health.

The gathering reflected a valuable commitment by the participating organisations to employee well-being and to spreading awareness beyond the clinical setting.

title: Empowering Through Awareness – Kuwait Flour Mills
organizer: Marketing Department – Public Relations Unit, Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co.
venue: Meeting Room Hall, Administration Building, Shuwaikh HQ, Kuwait
summary: A meaningful breast cancer awareness seminar bringing together employees of Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co., promoting informed healthcare decisions, early detection and greater awareness of women's health.
description:
As part of its annual Breast Cancer Awareness initiative, Kuwait Flour Mills & Bakeries Co. organised a special educational seminar titled Empowering Through Awareness at its Shuwaikh headquarters.

The programme brought together women employees for an informative session addressing cancer awareness, breast cancer risk factors, early warning signs and the importance of appropriate screening and timely medical consultation.

Through an engaging presentation supported by educational visuals, the session encouraged participants to take a proactive approach to their health and share this knowledge within their families and communities.

The initiative reflected the organisation's continued commitment to employee well-being, preventive healthcare education and spreading awareness beyond the hospital setting.
